summary: Software engineer with 2+ years of DevOps-related experience operating Linux VPS/Cloud servers for web products and internal platforms.
Hands-on with Nginx, MySQL/PostgreSQL, DNS, SSL, backup/migration, and server hardening.
Experienced in troubleshooting website downtime, slow performance, malware/security risks, and database-related issues with a reliability-first mindset.
Familiar with Docker, Git-based deployment/CI-CD, K8s, Cloudflare, and English communication for cross-border collaboration.

projects.name: Home Server Infrastructure (Proxmox Cluster)
bullets: Built and operated a 2-node Proxmox cluster from two home machines (20 vCPU, 96GB RAM, 5TB storage, 2 GPUs) for self-hosting and hands-on infrastructure practice.
Configured physical networking: router NAT port forwarding, DHCP reservation, switching, and Wi-Fi mesh setup.
Provisioned reusable VM/LXC templates and provided VPS environments with access control for student club members.
Set up domain and DNS management with Cloudflare, and deployed Nginx Proxy Manager for reverse proxy routing.
Hosted internal databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL) and ran a 3-VM Kubernetes cluster for educational workloads.
Operated and secured Linux servers/VMs across mixed environments; automated provisioning and baseline configuration with cloud-init and monitoring integrations.
Built and maintained hardening/compliance scripts, plus controlled harden/unharden workflows for audit, testing, and incident response.
Troubleshot production issues (service instability, performance bottlenecks, security findings) and improved uptime through preventive checks.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams in English to deliver stable, secure infrastructure support for internal products.
Built CI/CD workflows to automate testing, packaging, and deployment across multiple projects.
Authored shared reusable GitHub Actions steps/workflows to standardize pipelines and reduce duplicated CI logic.
Owned CI/CD pipelines for automated test execution, packaging, and deployment to improve release reliability.
Integrated monitoring/observability checks into delivery workflows for faster issue detection after releases.
